title: I'M STILL STANDING
lyrics_plain:
%-%-%-
You could never know what it's like.
Your blood like winter freezes just like ice,
And there's a cold lonely light
that shines from you.
You'll wind up like the wreck you hide
behind that mask you use.
Did you think this fool could never win.
Well, look at me I'm comin' back again.
I got a taste of love in a simple way,
and if you need to know while I'm still standin',
you just face away.
Don't you know,
I'm still standin' better than I ever did,
lookin' like a true survivor, feelin' like a little kid.
And I'm still standin' after all this time,
pickin' up the pieces of my life
without you on my mind.
I'm still standin', yea, yea, yea.
